lines.text: Athaliah destroys the royal heirs, but Jehosheba hides Joash with his nurse in the house of the LORD for six years.
In the seventh year, Jehoiada brings the commanders into the house of the LORD, makes a covenant, and shows them the king's son.
Jehoiada gives the commanders the spears and shields of King Saul, then crowns Joash and anoints him.
Athaliah sees the king by the pillar and cries "Treason!", and she is seized at the Fish Gate and put to death.
The people tear down the temple of Baal and kill Mattan, and Joash takes the throne at seven years old.
